name: reset-sent-card
title: Reset sent card
description: The "check your inbox" confirmation after a reset link is requested: an enumeration-safe message and a rate-limited resend.

when: After a password reset or magic link is requested.

builtIn: The resend button shows its cooldown in words and the pending state while sending.
youProvide: An enumeration-safe message: never say whether the account exists.

ResetSentCard.name: onResend
ResetSentCard.description: Sends the link again. A rejected promise (or a throw) starts no wait and shows `labels.resendFailed`.

ResetSentCard.name: cooldownSeconds
ResetSentCard.description: Seconds to disable "Resend" for after each successful send. Default 60.

ResetSentCard.name: initialCooldown
ResetSentCard.description:
The wait already running when the card appears. Default `cooldownSeconds`: the link was just sent. Pass 0 when the
card shows long after the send, or the server's "retry after"; a new value restarts the wait.

ResetSentCard.name: icon
ResetSentCard.description: Optional icon in place of the default check.

ResetSentCard.name: backSlot
ResetSentCard.description: "Back to sign in" affordance under the actions.

ResetSentCard.name: headingLevel
ResetSentCard.description: The title's heading level: 1 by default, or 2 when the page has its own h1.
